description: NYC child and dependent care credit (IT-216-I Worksheet 2, 2025), stop-condition gates: single, wages $31,000 -> FAGI $31,000 over the $30,000 cutoff ('If your FAGI is over $30,000 ... stop') -> $0 despite a $1,000 NYS credit and a 100% under-4 expense share. (The under-4 = $0 and total-expenses = $0 stops are the same or-gate; the ratio cap and factor never evaluate.)
